caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest or box lid, illustrated with decorative motifs and a clasp at the top center. The surface of the box is predominantly brown, giving the appearance of wood, and is bordered by a red-brown frame. The central area of the lid features floral patterns with large round flowers in red, orange, and blue, as well as green leaves and curly black stems. Among the floral patterns, on the left side, there is a human figure wearing a blue jacket and white pants, holding onto what appears to be a dog or a small four-legged animal. To the right of the human figure is a large black horse with its head facing left and one foreleg raised. Near the horse's hind legs is a tiny black silhouette of another animal. The overall composition is symmetrical, with floral designs filling the background around the figures. The artist's signature "M. PARISH" appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Chest
